title: docs(github): clarify pull_request_target workflow source
summary: Workflow documentation explains when pull_request_target changes become effective.
details: Readers can distinguish the base-branch workflow source from an unmerged PR's proposed automation changes.
Original GitHub merge 8fe527d612057d233529acb81373fa501e41a22d is distinct from rewritten main-history delivery 42e44f85ebced88d7f3a40e3e35703ce7a29f200; the merge date is the verified GitHub date.
